description: Recurrent/metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer with painful bone metastases and declining ECOG. Exercises the palliative-care specialist on P4, PSA-as-biomarker, and the recurrence+progression gate that should route to tumor-board surface.
query: 78 y.o. male with metastatic castration-resistant prostate adenocarcinoma, Gleason 9, multiple painful bone metastases including T12 vertebral lesion with early cord compression concern, PSA 450, ECOG 2, post-docetaxel progression. Patient and family prioritise quality of life. What are the best next-line options balancing life-prolonging therapy and symptom control?
